note: must_show items reworded under SPEC.md item 6c (revision 2 after first use; revision 3 after the second look; development). earlier: every earlier wording, oldest first (rev1: the wording before revision 2, rules/<regime>/rev1/); now: the wording in rules.json and the workflows (null: item removed). Designs and blind-check records name items by the wording of their time; the generator maps them through this file.

items.rev1: that and when CSS was notified of the theft
earlier: that and when CSS was notified of the theft
items.now: the date (day, month and year) on which the theft was notified to CSS

items.rev1: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2), or its absence
earlier: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2), or its absence
the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2), listed among the policy's covers as included or as not included
items.now: the complete list of the covers included in the policy (the supplementary insurance for simple theft away, Ziff. 24.2, is insured only if it is on that list)

items.rev1: where and when it was bought
earlier: where and when it was bought
for each item, where and when it was bought, or, for an item that was not bought, that it was a gift or inherited and when
items.now: for each item, where and when it was bought, or, for an item that was not bought, how and when it was acquired (for example as a gift or by inheritance)

items.rev1: the original voucher for each stolen or damaged item whose voucher can be obtained without considerable cost
earlier: the original voucher for each stolen or damaged item whose voucher can be obtained without considerable cost
items.now: an original purchase voucher for each stolen or damaged item, except an item for which the file states that its voucher cannot be obtained without considerable cost

items.rev1: the bicycle, if its voucher can be obtained without considerable cost
earlier: the bicycle, if its voucher can be obtained without considerable cost
items.now: the bicycle it is for (make, model or type)
Only if the file states that the policy includes the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2): the sum insured agreed for that cover. Otherwise this item does not apply.
